properties.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where EventID == 4625
| summarize FailedAttempts=count(), TargetAccounts=make_set(TargetUserName), SourceIPs=make_set(IpAddress) by SourceIp = IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where FailedAttempts > 10
| sort by FailedAttempts desc

metadata.description: Azure Sentinel Log Analytics Workspace Name
